Stock market news | SEBI Proposes Scrapping Additional Disclosure Rules For FPIs

SEBI has proposed scrapping the Additional Disclosure Framework for foreign portfolio investors. The regulator noted that India's ownership disclosure rules go beyond global norms and create entry barriers for foreign funds.
